equipment: Lauben 550BC stand mixer (flat beater, whisk, dough hook)

tips.title: Mixer attachments
tips.text: Flat beater for cakes, cookies and creaming butter. Whisk for egg whites, cream and sponge cake. Dough hook for bread and yeast dough.

tips.title: No fan for loaf cakes
tips.text: Use top & bottom heat for dense, tall cakes (banana, fruit, loaf). Fan browns and dries the top too fast. If using fan, lower the temperature by about 20°C.

tips.title: Glass tin
tips.text: Bake about 10-15°C lower than a metal tin, line with paper, check early, and never set it hot on a cold or wet surface.

tips.title: Dry outside, wet middle
tips.text: Lower heat and bake longer, tent with foil once brown, fill the tin only 2/3, or use a light metal tin.

tips.title: Andaliman substitute
tips.text: Sichuan pepper, toasted 1 minute in a dry pan, is the closest substitute.

tips.title: Where to shop in Prague
tips.text: Sapa market (Praha-Libuš) and Asian grocery shops for galangal, lemongrass, lime leaves, Sichuan pepper and chilies. Regular supermarkets for the rest.
